tasks.short: Help site managers apply our accounting rules, manage budgets and use money well.

today.trigger: A manager asks about spending, coding, budget ownership or an exception to policy.
steps: Read the request and clarify the transaction, site and decision needed.
Find the current SharePoint policy and inspect relevant AFAS transactions or budget figures.
Discuss practical options with the manager and agree the correct treatment.
Explain the decision and record any exception or follow-up.
drudgery: Finding the latest policy and approval limits
Answering repeated questions about coding and spending authority
Reconstructing the context from email threads
today.time_sinks: Likely concentrated in finding documents, clarifying incomplete requests and repeating explanations; this baseline needs observation.

lenses.faster: Retrieve the approved rule and relevant figures together, then draft an answer with links. Manual document hunting and repeated explanations largely disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A submitted finance question can trigger context collection and a draft response. Missing information and policy exceptions go to the controller.
lenses.ambitious: Give managers at all three sites consistent guidance before they commit spending, and use repeated questions to improve unclear policies.
lenses.joy: Remove searching and copying so the controller spends more time helping managers make sound decisions.
lenses.options: Compare permitted choices such as deferring expenditure, transferring budget or seeking an exception, with their cash and forecast effects.
lenses.altitude: Own the guidance service: maintain decision rules, review difficult cases and improve the policies behind recurring questions.
reach: Answer routine budget questions currently handled by FP&A analysts.
Help bookkeepers resolve recurring coding questions.

tasks.human_edge: Managers need someone who understands local pressures, can challenge spending constructively and takes responsibility for exceptions.
tasks.pattern_why: The system can retrieve and draft, but directing colleagues requires dialogue and judgment about the actual situation.

in_practice.trigger: A manager submits a question through a proposed Teams finance request form.
steps: Capture the site, amount, transaction type and decision deadline.
Retrieve current approved policies and permitted AFAS or budget records.
Draft a response citing policy clauses and identify missing facts or exceptions.
Let the controller edit and send the answer, then record the resolution.
in_practice.human_gate: The controller approves substantive advice; the Finance Director approves exceptions outside the controller's authority.
systems: AFAS Profit through a configured read-only GetConnector or controlled export
Proposed approved LLM service and request workflow
data_needed: Approved policies with owners, effective dates and approval limits
Chart of accounts and site cost-centre mappings
Current budgets and relevant transaction records
Previously approved answers and exceptions
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint finance guidance register recording sources, draft, final answer, approver and policy version.

evidence.claim: SharePoint supports document versioning and content approval, providing a foundation for an approved policy library.
A model can draft answers from retrieved policies, but Noordhaven's accuracy and exception handling require testing.
The 35% saving and 1.54x speedup are untested planning estimates.

risks: An obsolete policy or omitted exception produces confident but incorrect advice.
Broad retrieval permissions expose payroll, supplier or employee information beyond the requester's access.
Finance guidance about labour costs conflicts with CAO terms unless Payroll or HR validates the underlying interpretation.
research_questions: What proportion of requests repeat an approved answer, and how much time currently goes into finding it?
Does each policy have an authoritative version, effective date and named owner?
Can a pilot answer historical questions correctly while reliably escalating exceptions?

tasks.short: Explain what drives our results and find practical improvements across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo.

today.trigger: A close, forecast update or unexpected movement raises questions about operating performance.
steps: Collect AFAS actuals, budgets, forecasts and available site activity figures.
Reconcile totals and align periods, cost centres and agency labour costs.
Calculate variances and investigate the largest movements with site managers.
Present explanations, proposed actions and forecast implications.
systems: Power BI with its nightly AFAS extract
drudgery: Rebuilding variance tables
Combining inconsistent agency exports
Checking whether reports use the same period and allocation rules
today.time_sinks: Likely dominated by reconciliation, missing operational drivers and explaining differences between spreadsheets; actual availability of volume data is unknown.

lenses.faster: Calculate recurring variance bridges automatically and draft commentary from verified results. The controller starts with material exceptions rather than rebuilding tables.
lenses.autonomous: After a successful nightly refresh and reconciliation, rules identify material movements and prepare an investigation pack.
lenses.ambitious: Review site economics weekly and test whether agreed improvements actually change costs, cash or forecast accuracy.
lenses.joy: Replace spreadsheet assembly with conversations about why results changed and what operations can do next.
lenses.options: Compare volume, agency mix, overtime, price and utilisation scenarios, showing which conclusions depend on uncertain assumptions.
lenses.altitude: Design the operating driver model and challenge its explanations, rather than repeatedly producing the same analysis.
reach: Take on selected FP&A variance analysis and scenario preparation.
Provide the Credit and Collections Officer with analysis of site or customer drivers behind overdue balances.

tasks.human_edge: The controller distinguishes accounting timing from operating problems and tests explanations with people who understand the sites.
tasks.pattern_why: Several data sources and investigations must be combined; deterministic calculations support model-drafted explanations that need business validation.

in_practice.trigger: The nightly AFAS extract finishes successfully or a forecast version is approved.
steps: Validate freshness, completeness and reconciliation to the AFAS ledger.
Calculate approved variance bridges and flag material movements by site.
Join agency costs and available operating drivers using controlled mappings.
Draft explanations that separate calculated facts, hypotheses and missing evidence.
Have the controller validate causes with site managers before releasing actions or forecast changes.
in_practice.human_gate: The controller approves explanations and recommendations; FP&A retains ownership of its forecast and site managers confirm operational assumptions.
systems: AFAS Profit and the existing nightly extract
Controlled exports from the three staffing agency portals
Proposed scheduled calculation workflow and approved LLM service
data_needed: Reconciled actuals and versioned budgets and forecasts
Agency hours, rates, invoices and accruals
Site activity volumes and capacity measures, if available
Approved labour cost assumptions reflecting applicable CAOs
Cost allocation rules and an action register
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint analysis register linking Power BI snapshots, calculation versions, evidence, approved commentary and subsequent outcomes.

evidence.claim: Power BI supports threshold alerts on supported dashboard tiles, evaluated when data refreshes.
Variance bridges can be calculated with explicit rules; model-generated causal explanations still require operational evidence.
The 55% saving and 2.22x speedup are untested planning estimates.

risks: The nightly extract omits recent postings, and analysis is mistaken for a live view.
Missing volume measures or arbitrary allocations make site comparisons misleading.
A model presents a plausible explanation as a proven cause.
Extending aggregate cost analysis into individual worker assessment changes the privacy and employment implications and needs separate review.
research_questions: Are site activity volumes available at the same period and level as financial costs?
Can agency hours and accruals reconcile across all three portals and AFAS?
Does a retrospective pilot find useful causes without increasing false alarms or forecast error?
Does preparation, review and rework together fall enough to justify maintaining the workflow?

tasks.short: Coordinate financial audits and provide evidence that our accounts and controls meet Dutch requirements.

today.trigger: The external accountant requests evidence, an audit starts or a control issue needs investigation.
steps: Agree the audit scope, request list, deadlines and responsible colleagues.
Collect ledger exports, reconciliations, invoices, bank evidence and approvals.
Check completeness and investigate missing evidence or unexplained differences.
Discuss findings with the auditor and coordinate approved corrections.
drudgery: Matching audit requests to documents
Renaming files and maintaining evidence indexes
Chasing owners and repeating completeness checks
today.time_sinks: Evidence collection and follow-up probably consume more time than substantive audit judgments; the actual request mix needs measurement.

lenses.faster: Build indexed evidence packs and reconcile exports automatically. The controller reviews gaps and findings instead of assembling every folder.
lenses.autonomous: An audit request or scheduled control check can initiate evidence collection and flag missing items against a checklist.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain evidence throughout the year and test selected transaction populations between audits, reducing surprises at year end.
lenses.joy: Remove file administration and repeated chasing while retaining the investigative work and discussion of meaningful findings.
lenses.options: Offer the auditor population summaries, rule-based exceptions and proposed samples, with the selection method visible.
lenses.altitude: Own evidence quality and control coverage, and use audit findings to improve the financial process.
reach: Coordinate reconciliation evidence prepared by accountants.
Help the Finance Director track remediation of financial control findings.

tasks.human_edge: The controller handles sensitive findings, challenges weak explanations and preserves the external auditor's independent judgment.
tasks.pattern_why: Evidence collection spans systems and owners; automated checks are useful, but release, interpretation and remediation require accountable review.

in_practice.trigger: An approved audit request is registered or a scheduled financial control test becomes due.
steps: Translate the request into evidence requirements, owners and relevant periods.
Collect authorised exports and documents, retaining source identifiers and timestamps.
Reconcile populations and run approved completeness and exception tests.
Draft an evidence index and a list of unresolved issues.
Let the controller approve disclosure and discuss findings with the auditor.
in_practice.human_gate: The controller approves each external evidence pack and proposed finding; authorised accountants approve corrections, and the auditor decides audit conclusions.
systems: AFAS Profit exports, including XAF where suitable
Proposed evidence workflow and approved LLM service
data_needed: Audit scope, materiality and auditor-agreed request list
Transaction populations, opening balances and site dimensions
Bank statements, invoices, approvals and reconciliations
Control descriptions, access records and prior findings
in_practice.logs_to: The restricted SharePoint audit register, recording request IDs, export parameters, reconciliation results, evidence versions, reviewers and disclosures.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit exports XAF financial audit files; its documentation notes that opening balances and analytical dimensions require additional handling.
Rules can test transaction populations, while a model can map requests to evidence; neither establishes audit assurance by itself.
The 45% saving and 1.82x speedup are untested planning estimates.

risks: An incomplete export creates the appearance of complete audit coverage.
A model-generated summary omits contradictory evidence or invents a control conclusion.
Audit folders expose payroll or bank information beyond authorised recipients.
Combining control operation and review removes independent checking.
research_questions: Will the external auditor accept the proposed evidence format and source traceability?
Which required balances and site dimensions are missing from standard AFAS audit exports?
Can a pilot reproduce last year's evidence pack and detect deliberately missing items?
How much time remains in owner responses and auditor follow-up after collection is automated?

tasks.short: Write and maintain practical controls for budgets, payments, credit and accounting.

today.trigger: An annual review, audit finding, process change or incident exposes a missing or outdated control.
steps: Review the process, existing policies, actual system settings and recent failures.
Identify risks, approval responsibilities and required evidence.
Draft procedures and discuss feasibility with process owners.
Obtain approval, publish the policy and arrange implementation checks.
drudgery: Reformatting similar procedures
Comparing versions and resolving inconsistent wording
Updating the same approval limit in several documents
today.time_sinks: Document comparison and drafting are candidates for large savings; agreement on authority and workable controls remains substantial.

lenses.faster: Generate consistent procedures from an approved control register and highlight changes against the current policy.
lenses.autonomous: An approved process change or registered finding can trigger a policy impact check and prepare revised documents for approval.
lenses.ambitious: Give every important control a named owner, test method and evidence requirement, then track whether it actually operates.
lenses.joy: Remove boilerplate drafting and version comparison so the controller can solve practical control weaknesses with colleagues.
lenses.options: Compare tighter approval limits, system-enforced checks and independent review, showing workload and remaining exposure.
lenses.altitude: Design and maintain the control framework and test its effectiveness instead of treating policies as isolated documents.
reach: Standardise accountancy team procedures and reconciliation requirements.
Help the Finance Director maintain financial approval authorities.

tasks.human_edge: Someone must choose acceptable exposure, resolve authority disputes and confirm that proposed controls work on shifts across three sites.
tasks.pattern_why: Much of the document production can be automated, as the earlier classification suggests, but control design and approval cannot be delegated to generated text.

in_practice.trigger: A policy review date arrives or a process owner registers an approved change, incident or audit finding.
steps: Retrieve the affected policy, control register and verified process information.
Check approval limits, responsibilities and evidence requirements for inconsistencies.
Generate revised procedures and alternative controls with a clear change record.
Have process owners test feasibility and the controller resolve design questions.
Obtain Finance Director approval, publish the version and assign implementation checks.
in_practice.human_gate: The controller validates control design; the Finance Director approves policy and authority changes before publication or system configuration.
systems: Proposed control register, review workflow and approved LLM service
data_needed: Current approved policies and authority matrix
Actual AFAS and Rabobank permissions and workflow settings
Process maps, exception records and audit findings
Control owners, test results and approved legal guidance
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint control register linking policy versions, source evidence, approvals, configuration changes and effectiveness tests.

evidence.claim: SharePoint supports version histories and content approval for controlled policy publication.
Drafting from a structured control register is plausible, but verifying actual control operation remains separate work.
The 60% saving and 2.5x speedup are untested planning estimates.

risks: A polished procedure describes controls that AFAS permissions or daily practice do not enforce.
Generated changes weaken segregation between payment preparation, approval and release.

A finance policy extends into employee monitoring or personnel data processing without assessing applicable OR rights and AVG requirements. See [SER guidance](https://www.ser.nl/nl/thema/medezeggenschap/belangrijke-themas/privacy).
research_questions: Can existing policies be represented by one consistent control and authority register?
Do actual AFAS and Rabobank permissions match the written approval matrix?
How much revision is needed before process owners accept generated procedures?
Can each proposed control produce evidence that an independent reviewer can test?

tasks.short: Prepare the annual corporate tax pack and resolve questions with our external tax adviser.

today.trigger: The year-end accounts are ready and the external accountant requests information for the vennootschapsbelasting return.
steps: Agree the information request, reporting entity, tax year and timetable.
Extract the final trial balance, supporting schedules and prior-year tax records.
Reconcile accounting figures to proposed fiscal adjustments and investigate gaps.
Send the reviewed pack, resolve adviser questions and arrange authorised filing.
systems: Rabobank where payment evidence is needed
drudgery: Copying balances into recurring schedules
Finding supporting invoices and prior-year explanations
Tracking adviser questions across email threads
today.time_sinks: Pack assembly and reconciliation are likely candidates; late year-end adjustments and disputed tax treatments can still determine completion time.

lenses.faster: Populate recurring schedules from the approved trial balance and carry forward mappings and explanations for review.
lenses.autonomous: Approval of the year-end ledger snapshot can trigger pack preparation, completeness checks and a list of unresolved items.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a reconciled tax position during the year so annual preparation begins with fewer surprises.
lenses.joy: Remove balance copying and document chasing while retaining the useful work of resolving unusual transactions.
lenses.options: Show the effect of alternative adviser-approved treatments and identify which missing facts determine the answer.
lenses.altitude: Own the quality of tax data, reconciliations and evidence rather than repeatedly assembling the same annual pack.
reach: Prepare supporting tax schedules currently assembled by accountants.
Provide FP&A with an approved tax cash-flow schedule.

tasks.human_edge: The controller and tax adviser judge unusual treatments, evaluate supporting evidence and accept responsibility for the submitted position.
tasks.pattern_why: Extraction and reconciliation are structured, while tax adjustments and supporting explanations need specialist approval before disclosure or filing.

in_practice.trigger: The Finance Director approves the year-end ledger snapshot and the adviser confirms the request list.
steps: Freeze the source snapshot and validate entity, period and control totals.
Populate agreed tax schedules using versioned account mappings and deterministic calculations.
Reconcile commercial and fiscal figures, flagging unmapped balances and changed assumptions.
Draft evidence-linked explanations and collect unresolved questions in one register.
Have the controller and adviser approve the pack, then retain the authorised filing receipt.
in_practice.human_gate: The controller approves the information pack; the qualified tax adviser validates tax positions and the authorised filer approves submission.
systems: Proposed calculation workflow and approved LLM service
External adviser's filing software, outside the proposed automation
data_needed: Final trial balance, ledger detail and approved year-end journals
Prior-year return, assessments and commercial-to-fiscal reconciliation
Fixed asset schedules, provisions and relevant contracts
Adviser-approved tax mappings, rules and information checklist
in_practice.logs_to: The restricted SharePoint annual tax dossier, retaining source snapshots, mapping versions, adjustments, evidence, approvals and filing receipt.

evidence.claim: Configured AFAS GetConnectors retrieve records from Profit through REST/JSON, supporting repeatable extraction.
A corporate tax pack must reconcile commercial figures with applicable fiscal adjustments; the proposed workflow is a design inference from official guidance.
The 50% saving and 2x speedup are untested planning estimates.

risks: A late journal changes balances after the tax pack has been generated.
Prior-year mappings silently repeat an incorrect or outdated tax treatment.
Automated explanations conceal missing evidence or mix corporate tax with VAT and payroll tax obligations.
External adviser turnaround may prevent preparation savings from shortening the filing cycle.
research_questions: What share of annual effort is pack preparation versus adviser questions and tax judgment?
Will the adviser agree a stable pack format and explicit reconciliation checks?
Can last year's pack be reproduced from source records without unexplained differences?
Can the workflow detect and invalidate schedules affected by late journals?

tasks.short: Compare legitimate tax options for investments and reflect the agreed position in cash forecasts.

today.trigger: A material investment, financing decision or forecast change warrants tax review.
steps: Collect investment plans, financial forecasts, contracts and existing tax positions.
Ask the tax adviser which treatments or incentives could apply.
Calculate cash and accounting effects under the relevant assumptions.
Discuss the options with management and record the approved approach and deadlines.
drudgery: Rebuilding similar cash-flow comparisons
Checking which assumptions changed between versions
Collecting specifications and dates needed for adviser review
today.time_sinks: Data collection and scenario preparation can shrink; specialist interpretation, eligibility evidence and business decisions remain.

lenses.faster: Prepare consistent scenario calculations and an adviser briefing from the same investment and forecast data.
lenses.autonomous: A proposed capital commitment can trigger a tax review checklist and flag missing facts or approaching deadlines.
lenses.ambitious: Review all material capital plans early enough to consider legitimate incentives before contracts are committed.
lenses.joy: Reduce assumption chasing and spreadsheet revision so the controller can discuss commercially useful choices.
lenses.options: Compare purchase, lease, timing and adviser-confirmed incentive scenarios, separating tax timing benefits from permanent savings.
lenses.altitude: Design a repeatable tax review at investment approval and maintain a reliable view of tax cash exposure.
reach: Add tax cash scenarios to FP&A investment models.
Prepare decision briefings for the Finance Director and external tax adviser.

tasks.human_edge: The tax adviser interprets the law; management weighs cash, operational needs and uncertainty before choosing an approach.
tasks.pattern_why: Scenario preparation can be accelerated, but appropriate tax planning depends on facts, current rules and specialist judgment.

in_practice.trigger: A material investment proposal or changed forecast is submitted for finance review.
steps: Collect the business purpose, contract dates, technical specifications and forecast assumptions.
Retrieve dated official guidance and draft questions about potentially relevant treatments.
Ask the tax adviser to confirm applicable rules, eligibility assumptions and deadlines.
Run deterministic cash-flow scenarios using the confirmed assumptions and show sensitivities.
Have the controller present options for management approval and record follow-up obligations.
in_practice.human_gate: The external tax adviser validates interpretations and eligibility; the Finance Director approves the chosen position before commitments or claims.
systems: Proposed approved LLM service for research summaries and briefings
data_needed: Versioned investment pipeline and cash forecasts
Contract, commitment, payment and commissioning dates
Technical specifications and supplier evidence
Adviser-confirmed tax assumptions and eligibility criteria
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint tax decision register containing dated sources, adviser confirmations, scenario versions, approvals and deadline tracking.

evidence.claim: RVO publishes investment-specific EIA eligibility conditions; using these to prepare review questions is plausible, but eligibility cannot be inferred from an invoice description alone.
Deterministic scenario models can calculate cash effects once a tax adviser confirms the rules and assumptions.
The 35% saving and 1.54x speedup are untested planning estimates.

risks: A model uses obsolete rules or suggests an incentive for an ineligible asset.
A missed commitment or notification deadline removes an expected benefit.
An attractive tax scenario rests on unrealistic operating assumptions or double-counted incentives.
Adviser availability limits end-to-end speed despite faster preparation.
research_questions: How many material decisions each year justify tax scenario work?
Are proposals visible before contractual commitments and relevant deadlines?
Will the adviser approve a reusable assumption set and scenario template?
Does a historical pilot identify valid options without overstating eligibility or benefits?

tasks.short: Set supported depreciation assumptions and compare buying, leasing or replacing trucks and warehouse equipment.

today.trigger: An asset is acquired, a useful-life review is due or management considers buying, leasing or disposing of equipment.
steps: Collect asset costs, commissioning dates, specifications and supplier or lease quotations.
Assess the asset category, useful life, residual value and accounting and tax treatment.
Calculate depreciation and compare purchase, lease, retention and disposal cash flows.
Discuss operational assumptions with the site and obtain approval for the treatment and recommendation.
drudgery: Rekeying asset details and quotations
Recalculating depreciation schedules
Rebuilding purchase-versus-lease comparisons
today.time_sinks: Routine calculations and data entry can largely disappear; reliable useful lives, residual values and operating assumptions still require investigation.

lenses.faster: Extract quotation details for checking and calculate schedules and ownership costs from approved assumptions.
lenses.autonomous: An approved asset addition can trigger a proposed asset record, depreciation schedule and reconciliation checks.
lenses.ambitious: Review the economics of material assets before replacement, including maintenance, energy, downtime and disposal value.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated calculations so the controller can challenge supplier offers and discuss equipment needs with operations.
lenses.options: Compare buying, leasing, extending current use and replacing earlier across utilisation, maintenance and residual-value scenarios.
lenses.altitude: Own asset economics and the depreciation policy, with routine schedules generated by software.
reach: Prepare fixed-asset schedules and reconciliation support for accountants.
Add lifecycle cost comparisons to FP&A capital expenditure reviews.

tasks.human_edge: Operations must validate expected use and downtime, while the controller judges accounting estimates and management decides capital allocation.
tasks.pattern_why: Deterministic software can produce most schedules and comparisons, but setting estimates and recommending purchases still require approval.

in_practice.trigger: A capital proposal, approved asset purchase or material change in asset use is registered.
steps: Extract invoice or quotation fields and check them against source documents.
Apply approved asset-category defaults and flag missing or unusual assumptions.
Calculate separate commercial and fiscal schedules and purchase, lease and disposal scenarios.
Have operations validate usage and the controller approve estimates and accounting treatment.
Route the capital recommendation for approval and reconcile approved asset records to the ledger.
in_practice.human_gate: The controller approves useful life, residual value and treatment; the Finance Director or delegated authority approves the capital decision before commitment.
systems: AFAS Profit fixed-assets functionality, if licensed and configured
Controlled Excel asset register and scenario model if that functionality is unavailable
Proposed document extraction and calculation workflow
data_needed: Asset register reconciled to AFAS and approved depreciation policy
Invoices, quotations, lease terms and commissioning dates
Maintenance, energy, utilisation and downtime assumptions
Residual-value evidence and adviser-approved fiscal treatment
Approved discount rate and capital approval limits
in_practice.logs_to: The restricted SharePoint capital decision dossier, linked to asset IDs, source documents, calculation versions, approvals and AFAS reconciliation results.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit supports commercial and fiscal depreciation schedules; availability at Noordhaven must be confirmed.
AFAS provides a report comparing fixed-asset depreciation with the financial ledger.
Fiscal depreciation needs separate treatment from commercial estimates; the proposed approval workflow is a design inference from official guidance.
The 60% saving and 2.5x speedup are untested planning estimates.

risks: Category defaults become unsupported useful lives or residual values.
Commercial depreciation, fiscal deductions and lease accounting are incorrectly treated as interchangeable.
A comparison omits maintenance, mileage limits, downtime, termination terms or disposal costs.
An asset record or journal is duplicated when an automated run retries.
research_questions: Is AFAS fixed-assets functionality already licensed, configured and reconciled to the ledger?
Can operations provide defensible useful-life, maintenance and utilisation assumptions?
Do historical purchase and lease comparisons change materially when full lifecycle costs are included?
Can the pilot reproduce approved schedules and flag unusual assets without duplicate records or postings?

role.altitude: Become the owner of financial control quality and trusted operating explanations: design repeatable workflows, investigate exceptions and help managers act on reliable figures.
reach: Absorb selected FP&A variance preparation and capital scenario modelling while FP&A retains forecast ownership.
Standardise accountants' reconciliation and audit evidence packs.
Help bookkeepers prevent recurring coding and approval errors.
Provide the Finance Director with a maintained control register, capital decision record and tax cash outlook.
role.ceiling_note: These seven tasks cover 279.6 hours a year, about 17.5% of the supplied role baseline. The estimates imply roughly 134 hours released annually, worth about EUR 12,800 at EUR 95/hour before setup, licences, maintenance and overlap; this is capacity, not an automatic cash saving. Today's workflows and all anatomy percentages are inferred from the fictional context. Speedups are untested estimates for complete task runs including review; external waits can substantially reduce them. Missing operational data, specialist tax judgment and approval responsibilities limit further automation.
skills_to_grow: Define reconciliations, data freshness checks and acceptance criteria.
Build and review deterministic Excel, Power Query or scripted calculations.
Design financial controls, segregation of duties and evidence retention.
Test model outputs for unsupported explanations, missing evidence and incorrect policy use.
Translate operational drivers into financial scenarios and challenge assumptions with site managers.
Apply AVG/GDPR access restrictions and recognise when proposed changes require HR, OR or legal review.
role.ambitious_version: Run a financial control and insight service across all three sites: reconciled daily exception checks, a continuously prepared close and audit dossier, weekly operating explanations and capital decisions with explicit cash scenarios. Measure success through days to close, forecast accuracy, DSO, invoices processed without touch and audit adjustments. Start with reconciled data and repeatable calculations, then add model drafting where outputs can be checked. Keep workforce analysis aggregated; any expansion into individual employment decisions needs a separate assessment of applicable CAOs, OR rights, AVG/GDPR and EU AI Act requirements, whose classification depends on intended use. See [European Commission AI Act guidance](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/faqs/navigating-ai-act).
